sites.name: Sceilg Mhichíl (Skellig Michael)
sites.era: ancient (era not stated on the pages read)
sites.what: UNESCO World Heritage monastery reached by an 11.5 km boat trip; the climb is 618 steps.

access.opening: 12 May to September 2026, weather dependent; outside staffed times visits are prohibited. The OPW page looks ahead to 2027.
access.tickets: Free admission; boat operators charge separately.
access.permits: Access only with boat operators who hold a permit; children under 12 are not permitted; stay on recognised paths.

ancient-sites-and-mysteries.evidence: Official pages; read directly unless marked search snapshot.
ancient-sites-and-mysteries.summary: Skellig Michael access rules from the OPW.

laws.rule: Skellig Michael can only be visited with a permitted boat operator during the staffed season; children under 12 are not permitted and visitors must follow OPW guide instructions.
